title: 餐厅过滤器
key_insight: 使用窗口函数计算移动平均值，筛选满足条件的记录
approach: SQL窗口函数AVG() OVER配合日期范围
code_python3:
# SQL Solution
SELECT visited_on,
       amount,
       ROUND(average_amount, 2) AS average_amount
FROM (
    SELECT visited_on,
           SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount,
           AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS average_amount,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY visited_on) AS rn
    FROM (SELECT visited_on, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM Customer GROUP BY visited_on) t
) sub
WHERE rn >= 7;

title: 广告效果
key_insight: 计算点击率CTR，注意除零处理
approach: GROUP BY + CASE WHEN计算比率
code_python3:
# SQL Solution
SELECT ad_id,
       IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN action='Clicked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) /
              NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN action IN ('Clicked','Viewed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 2), 0) AS ctr
FROM Ads
GROUP BY ad_id
ORDER BY ctr DESC, ad_id;

title: 翻转子数组得到最大的数组值
key_insight: 分析翻转区间对相邻差绝对值之和的影响，利用数学推导优化
approach: 枚举边界情况+数学分析中间段翻转的最大增益
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def maxValueAfterReverse(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        base = sum(abs(nums[i] - nums[i+1]) for i in range(n-1))
        # Case 1: reverse starting from index 0 or ending at index n-1
        gain = 0
        for i in range(1, n-1):
            gain = max(gain, abs(nums[0] - nums[i+1]) - abs(nums[i] - nums[i+1]))
            gain = max(gain, abs(nums[-1] - nums[i-1]) - abs(nums[i] - nums[i-1]))
        # Case 2: reverse middle segment
        mx = float('-inf')
        mn = float('inf')
        for i in range(n-1):
            a, b = nums[i], nums[i+1]
            mx = max(mx, min(a, b))
            mn = min(mn, max(a, b))
        gain = max(gain, 2 * (mx - mn))
        return base + gain

title: 每次访问的交易次数
key_insight: 生成连续数字序列，LEFT JOIN统计每个访问的交易次数分布
approach: 递归CTE生成序列 + 分组统计
code_python3:
# SQL Solution
WITH RECURSIVE seq AS (
    SELECT 0 AS transactions_count
    UNION ALL
    SELECT transactions_count + 1 FROM seq WHERE transactions_count < (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(t.transaction_date) cnt FROM Visits v LEFT JOIN Transactions t ON v.user_id=t.user_id AND v.visit_date=t.transaction_date GROUP BY v.user_id, v.visit_date) tmp)
),
visit_trans AS (
    SELECT v.user_id, v.visit_date, COUNT(t.transaction_date) AS cnt
    FROM Visits v LEFT JOIN Transactions t ON v.user_id=t.user_id AND v.visit_date=t.transaction_date
    GROUP BY v.user_id, v.visit_date
)
SELECT s.transactions_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN vt.cnt=s.transactions_count THEN 1 END), 0) AS visits_count
FROM seq s LEFT JOIN visit_trans vt ON s.transactions_count = vt.cnt
GROUP BY s.transactions_count;

code_python3:
# SQL Solution
(SELECT u.name AS results
FROM MovieRating mr JOIN Users u ON mr.user_id = u.user_id
GROUP BY mr.user_id
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, u.name
LIMIT 1)

FROM MovieRating mr JOIN Movies m ON mr.movie_id = m.movie_id
